description.text: A unit of electrical potential equal to one hundred millionth of a volt ($10^{-8}\,volts$), used in the centimeter-gram-second (CGS) system of units. One abV is the potential difference that exists between two points when the work done to transfer one abcoulomb of charge between them equals: $1\,erg\cdot\,1\,abV\,=\,10\,nV$.
